summary: Iteration 10 regression (Expo Go crash after ~30 images → picker + FlatList virtualization + WebP thumbnail rewrite). All customer/admin flows on the 120-photo stress album PASS on the web preview (390x844). Login via OTP+dev_hint works (mobile 9876500777). /create/upload?albumId=09fdba…: upload-count reads '120 PHOTOS', grid testID upload-photo-grid scrolls smoothly (scrollHeight 5128, clientHeight 772) with FlatList virtualization observed — 120 mounted at t=0 but 66 after scroll to bottom (removeClippedSubviews drops off-screen rows). Sample thumb src ends .webp and fetch returned status=200 content-type=image/webp. upload-remove- removes a tile (120→119 PHOTOS) and 'Design my album (119 photos)' remains enabled. /create/cover: cover-list FlatList visible with 3 seeded active covers (cover-d100…, cover-0b58…, cover-dd82…), plus cover-back and cover-continue; GET /api/covers?offset=0&limit=10 returns {covers,total:3,offset:0,limit:10,next_offset:null} — legacy 'covers' key preserved and every item has thumbnail_url. /create/style?albumId=…: horizontal cover-photo strip renders (8 items initially mounted from 119 photos; horizontal FlatList virtualization active), tapping cover-photo- shows the check badge overlay (verified via screenshot). /album/{id}/preview: 3D preview loads, front cover + pages 5-6 of 80 render, preview-next flips pages without errors. /album/{id}/editor: editor-tool-photos → editor-photos-list virtualized (12 photos-page- rows mounted initially, 25 after scroll to bottom of 80 rows). Swap flow: photos-slot-0-0 then photos-slot-1-0 swapped image src correctly (before slot10=62b0…webp / after slot00=62b0…webp; slot10 became empty then repopulated after PUT completes — assertion 'swapped:True'). /album/{id}/page?index=0: page-tool-replace strip mounts 10 replace-photo- tiles from 119 photos (horizontal FlatList — scrollWidth 1024 / clientWidth 390; 19 mounted after scrolling right); replace-upload-new tile visible; tapping a replace-photo- replaces the canvas image (previews/62b0…webp → previews/7b0a5f…webp). page-editor-save exists (rendered as 'Save & Preview' button testID=page-editor-save). My Books: 10+ album-card- testIDs render with cover thumbnails (top row = Stress 120, 119 photos · 40 sheets · DRAFT). Home drafts still render via home-draft-. Admin covers (login admin/clickbook@2026): /admin/covers lists all 6 covers (active+inactive) via GET /api/covers?admin=true&limit=100 → total:6, items:6; testIDs admin-cover-add + 6× admin-cover- visible; pagination did not break admin. Backend paginated envelopes verified via pytest (5 pass / 1 skip): covers/backgrounds/layouts all expose total/offset/limit/next_offset AND their legacy top-level keys; thumbnail_url is set on every returned cover. Minor observations (non-blocking, reported): (1) RN-Web console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — new deprecation surfaced by this iteration's changes; (2) pre-existing shadow* → boxShadow deprecation still present (tracked since iter 8); (3) upload grid mounts all 120 at t=0 before user scrolls — RN-Web FlatList ignores initialNumToRender/windowSize on first paint until the container scrolls (virtualization DOES kick in on scroll → 66 mounted). On Expo Go this is not an issue because RN-native FlatList honours initialNumToRender; recording as an FYI for the web preview only. No VirtualizedList-nesting warnings, no red-screen errors, no failing API calls, no Razorpay/checkout was invoked.

react_native_issues.issue: New RN-Web deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' surfaced during editor / page-editor interactions this iteration. Likely a Pressable/View prop introduced in the FlatList strips. Reference: search /app/frontend/app/album/[id]/editor.tsx and /app/frontend/app/album/[id]/page.tsx for pointerEvents="…" props and move them into style.pointerEvents.
Non-blocking deprecation 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' still present across page.tsx and other files. Same as iter 8/9.

RN-Web's FlatList does not honour initialNumToRender/windowSize on the very first paint — all 120 tiles are mounted before the user scrolls, then removeClippedSubviews drops off-screen rows (120→66 after scrolling to the bottom of the stress album). Only relevant to the web preview; native (Expo Go) FlatList virtualization is unaffected.

action_items: LOW: Migrate remaining RN shadow* style props to boxShadow.
LOW: Replace props.pointerEvents=… with style.pointerEvents=… on Views/Pressables (grep /app/frontend/app/album/[id]/ for pointerEvents=).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/catalog.py: with_thumbnails() looks up admin_images by URL in one query — no N+1. _small_variant() only rewrites Unsplash-style w= params; images without w= fall through to the original URL. Acceptable as a best-effort optimisation.

/app/frontend/app/create/upload.tsx: FlatList config (initialNumToRender=12, windowSize=3, removeClippedSubviews, getItemLayout) is correct for native. On web the initial mount currently paints all rows; consider gating a 'web only' initialNumToRender=15 via Platform.OS === 'web' if you want to squeeze the web preview too — but Expo Go (the actual target) is fine.

/app/frontend/app/album/[id]/page.tsx: replace-photo strip works as expected — horizontal FlatList virtualizes on horizontal scroll (10→19 mounted after scrollLeft > 600). replace-upload-new sibling is rendered in ListHeaderComponent, so it's always accessible without scrolling.

/app/frontend/app/album/[id]/editor.tsx: Photos-tab editor-photos-list virtualizes correctly (12→25 rows mounted around the viewport). Swap flow issues an async PUT /albums/{id}/pages and the UI temporarily clears the destination slot image before the fetch resolves — the intermediate 'null' image state can be noticeable on slow networks; consider optimistic swap instead of clear-then-set.

rca_of_issue: N/A — regression PASSED. Root cause fix (picker quality 1 + FlatList virtualization + WebP thumbnails/previews + expo-image memory-disk cache + paginated catalog endpoints) is behaving as designed on the web preview: thumbnails are served as image/webp (verified via in-page fetch), off-screen rows are unmounted after scrolling on both vertical (upload/editor Photos) and horizontal (style cover-photo strip, page-editor replace strip) FlatLists, catalog endpoints return the paginated envelope while preserving their legacy top-level keys, and admin still receives all covers via ?admin=true&limit=100.
